dashboard.heroSubtitle: Kisan Match connects farmers with nearby tractors, harvesters and implements — matched by a model that understands your crop, land and schedule.
dashboard.processTitle: Three steps from field to finish
dashboard.step1Desc: Tell us your crop, operation, land size, location and date — guided, not a form.
dashboard.step2Desc: Our ML model ranks nearby equipment by fit, availability, distance and price.
dashboard.step3Desc: Confirm in a tap, then track your equipment from dispatch to field.

describeJob.freetextTitle: Describe your job, in your own words
describeJob.freetextSub: English, Hindi, Marathi, or mixed — however you'd normally say it. Or skip and fill it in step by step.
describeJob.freetextPlaceholder: e.g. Mujhe 5 acre kapas ki jotai karni hai agle hafte…
describeJob.skipManual: Skip, I'll fill it in manually
describeJob.parseFailed: Couldn't reach the AI parser right now — no problem, just fill in the steps below.
describeJob.parseOkFilled: Got it — pre-filled below from your description. Check each step and adjust anything that's off.
describeJob.parseOkPartial: Understood most of it — please confirm the operation below.
describeJob.cropSub: This helps us match equipment built for your crop.
describeJob.operationSub: Choose the operation you need done.
describeJob.landSub: Drag to set the area for this job.
describeJob.locationSub: Enter your village or let us use your current location.
describeJob.dateSub: Pick the date you'd like the work to start.
describeJob.notesPlaceholder: Anything else the owner should know? (optional)
describeJob.reviewSub: We'll match this against nearby equipment.
describeJob.prefilledNotice: Pre-filled from your description ({{provider}}) — double-check before continuing.
describeJob.submitError: Something went wrong finding matches. Please try again.
